Task 04 used the official Guessless per-server approval mode and received a closed refused receipt because the benchmark root had a synthetic node_modules symlink. The agent made no safety claim.

Before the unlaunched tasks 05-06, onboarding-v3c froze the exact symlink-free packages/frameworks/react root. Both treatments received complete snapshots and bounded partial impact results. No launched cell was repaired, retried, resumed, or substituted.
